name: Seller saves a draft and pays a server-calculated listing fee
description: Verifies the seller's listing draft is durable before a Paystack checkout is initialized and the amount comes from the server.
steps: Sign in as a seller and submit a valid product with two photos
Choose Pay for just this listing
Confirm a pending payment record is created and the browser is sent to Paystack hosted checkout
expected: The draft remains saved, the amount is calculated by the server from the listing price, and the seller is redirected to the Paystack authorization URL.

name: Plan and waiver requests are held for admin approval
covers: monthly plan and six-month plan choices
published listings remain live after plan expiry
expired plans block new listings without hiding existing listings
held products while plan payment awaits verification
description: Verifies plan and waiver choices create durable records and admin approval controls which listings are released.
steps: Submit a listing without an active plan
Choose a monthly or six-month plan and complete a test payment
As admin, verify and approve the payment
Submit another listing and request a waiver for it
After the plan expiry date, reopen the marketplace and try to submit another listing
expected: Paid plans become active only after admin approval with the configured expiry; held listings move into normal listing review; existing Live products remain visible after the plan expires, while new listing submissions require renewal; and a waiver applies only to its linked product.

name: Paystack callback and webhook verification are idempotent
covers: callback and webhook process a reference only once
user manual verify and continue payment
description: Verifies payment success is accepted only after server-side verification and repeated callback/webhook events do not duplicate processing.
steps: Complete a Paystack test transaction
Return to the Danzo callback page
Deliver the matching charge.success webhook and use I've paid, check now
expected: The reference is marked paid once only when Paystack confirms success and the NGN amount matches the stored amount; approval remains pending for admin.

name: User can recover a pending payment and resume a rejected item
covers: rejected payment reason and retry options
description: Verifies interrupted payments remain recoverable and rejected items retain their drafts and payment history.
steps: Start a test payment and close the Paystack tab before finishing
Log back into Danzo and open My Listings
Choose Continue payment or I've paid, check now
After an admin rejection, reopen payment choices for the same draft
expected: The same reference and hosted payment URL are reused, pending status can be checked, and rejected records remain stored while the saved draft can be paid again.

name: Admin reviews payments and legacy receipt records remain intact
covers: admin payment queue and owner/product details
legacy receipt and payment records retained
admin can preview listing photos and full product details before approval
seller can edit all details of an approved listing from My Listings
description: Verifies admins can inspect listing photos and full details before approval, sellers can edit their approved listings, and payment records remain intact.
steps: Sign in as a seller, open My Listings, and edit the details of an approved listing
Save the changes, reload My Listings, and confirm the updated details remain
Open Admin and select Products
Inspect the submitted product photos, description, category, condition, price and seller details before approving it
Review a payment record and confirm historical records remain stored
expected: The seller's approved listing changes persist and are visible in the marketplace; the admin product queue displays the submitted photos and full product details before approval; and payment approval metadata is saved without deleting legacy records.
